author: TanmayK_03
text:
New CVE-2026-77604 in Code Graph RAG's MCP server (fixed in 0.0.345): read_file skipped its path check when offset or limit was set.

That branch did Path(root) / user_path, and pathlib drops root for absolute paths.

Your own tools: resolve(), then relative_to(root).
